SessionStart.description: Pre-warm credential discovery: list which claude-team-toolkit profiles are configured (trello, linear, azure-devops, heroku, sentry, slack, firebase, shopify, postgres, maestro, fastlane, k6, rspec) and the active default per service. Output is advisory only — never blocks.

hooks.command: p="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/heroku_guard.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; if python -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1; then python "$p"; elif py -3 -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1; then py -3 "$p"; elif python3 -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$p"; fi

PreToolUse.description: Refuse state-changing Heroku CLI commands run through Bash. A permission rule matches the command string by prefix and every shell wrapping defeats it; this hook scans the whole command. Fails open on error. Set CTT_GUARDS=off to disable.

hooks.command: p="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/mcp_only_guard.py"; [ -f "$p" ] || exit 0; if python -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1; then python "$p"; elif py -3 -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1; then py -3 "$p"; elif python3 -c "" >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "$p"; fi

PreToolUse.description: Refuse hand-written HTTP to api.linear.app, api.heroku.com and any /_apis/ URL. The azure-devops, heroku and linear skills go through MCP, where permission tiers apply; a raw curl is subject to none of them. git is untouched. Fails open on error. Set CTT_GUARDS=off to disable.
